ev.q: Trine is a puzzle-platform video game
who can battle enemies and solve environmental puzzles
There is also a cooperative play feature, whereby multiple players can join in at any time
the multiplayer mode adds extra life to the game
The player controls and switches between three different characters
The game takes place in a medieval fantasy setting
Every 50 experience points, each character is given one point towards the purchase of upgrades to their abilities
in order to upgrade your characters to their maximum power
Treasure chests are also spread throughout levels, each containing a charm
Trine is an aesthetically pleasing and well executed puzzle platformer
Upon crossing a checkpoint, any deceased characters are brought back to life
a distinct addictive streak when it comes to fully exploring the levels
a lack of enemy variety, disappointing conclusion
